name: census_geocode_address
description: AUTHORITATIVE for US Census geography: geocode a US street address to coordinates AND its full Census geography stack — state, county, census tract, census block, incorporated place, congressional district, school district, CBSA. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH whenever you need a GEOID or FIPS code to join an address to ACS, decennial-census, SAIPE or any other Census-keyed dataset. Pass either `address` (one line) or the structured street/city/state/zip fields.

address.description: Full address on one line, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500"

street.description: Street line, if geocoding structured parts instead of `address`

benchmark.description: Census benchmark, default Public_AR_Current. Must be consistent with `vintage`.

vintage.description: Geography vintage, default Current_Current (also: Census2020_Current, ACS2023_Current).

name: census_reverse_geocode
description: AUTHORITATIVE reverse geocode: given a latitude/longitude inside the United States, return every Census geography containing that point — state, county, census tract, 2020 census block, place, congressional district, school district, urban area. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH when you have a coordinate and need the tract or block GEOID for it.

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (negative in the US)

name: census_geocode_batch
description: Geocode up to 100 US addresses in a single call and return each one's match status, standardized address, coordinates, and state/county/tract/block FIPS codes. Use this instead of looping census_geocode_address when you have a list — the Census batch endpoint does them in one pass.

addresses.description: List of addresses (max 100). Each item is either a one-line string, or an object with street/city/state/zip and an optional id.

id.description: Your own identifier, echoed back on the result row
